title: Lightscale AI: the free and secure AI builder for business applications
excerpt: Lightscale AI is the free AI builder for business applications. No credits. Access checked on the server, records migrated safely, hosted in Switzerland.
content_html:
Now with free hostingPrompting is always free

Create custom business software with AI. Secure by design,
shaped by you.

Describe the software you need: a CRM, a web shop, applicant tracking, or any other business tool. Lightscale AI builds it for you, with secure sign-in, access control, and protected data built in. Hosted in Switzerland. Free to build.

Create for free

Create and refine your application for free, and host your first one free in Switzerland. Hosting further applications and source download cost CHF 50 a month per project, each.

Less manual work,
fewer bottlenecks,
faster results.

From HR to finance to sales: purpose-built tools that take the friction out of everyday processes.

Explore the product

Time off, requested and approved in one place.

Employees request PTO, the software checks for clashes in the team, their manager approves, and the balance and team calendar update automatically.

Hosting or downloadCHF 50 / month

Each, per project. Your first application is hosted free. Stop anytime.

Changes stay free and reach your software
in under a minute.

A change usually reaches your software application in under a minute, with your records carried over. Prompting stays free after your team starts using the application. Your first application is hosted free; hosting further applications and source download cost CHF 50 a month per project, each.

See how pricing works

Your data stays protected and GDPR-ready through every change and migration.

Change your software application as often as you need: your records carry forward, nothing is deleted without your OK, and personal data stays protected. Every application that holds personal data gets a privacy page, a data-protection dashboard, and GDPR and Swiss FADP documents.

The technology behind it
